cards.power: The Acid Resist. Eddie is fit to his Acid Lacqueur, he stands ground and off into the 5.5 Critical Point.

verdict: The Oral Arena is the strongest specialty deck in the MedKayfab series so far. The naming game is flawless — Dry-Socket Dan, NaOCl-Nate, Peri-Implant-Iris, Total-Tony — every card earns its name. The arc from Eddie Enamel to THE ORAL ARENA QUESTS covers all of dentistry in one coherent thriller. Weakness: Bracket Benny literally calls himself 'just a passenger,' and the synthesis card (56) is meta not playable. Table-ready: YES.
blurb: 56 dental gladiators from Enamel to Dentures — every tooth, every villain, every drill move as a playable card. For dental students who learn by fighting.

marketingText:
MedKayfab: Dentistry – The Oral Arena (Medical Mnemonics Cut & Play Comic)

56 illustrated medical mnemonic cards to master the decay war, the root canal, and the full rebuild from first filling to final denture.

The patient grips the armrest and jabs a finger at a lower molar that has been throbbing since Tuesday. Cold makes it worse. Heat makes it worse. The pain now arrives a half second before your explorer even touches the tooth. That is not a cavity anymore. That is pressure trapped inside a sealed chamber with nowhere to vent, and the clock on saving the nerve started running days ago. One chair, one probe, ninety seconds to read the whole story in the mouth in front of you.

MedKayfab Dentistry translates the running battle of the oral cavity into a narrative wrestling match, from the first acid hit on enamel to the titanium screw that replaces whatever the acid won. Stop memorizing tooth anatomy and bacterial names as separate lists. Start performing the fight between the structure that holds and the swarm that dissolves it.

YOU'LL GET
- 56 illustrated MedKayfab cards (14pp, 4 cards/page)
- Full MedKayfab Freestyle rules (Quest Die mechanics)
- S-Tier characters like Dry-Socket Dan, NaOCl-Nate, and Ti-Titan
- Free lifetime updates as guidelines and materials evolve
- CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence, print, share, and adapt freely
- PDF optimized for home printing (A4 / Letter)

What's in the deck
The roster runs the length of the tooth and the length of a career. Eddie Enamel is the armored shield who holds the line at the critical pH of 5.5 and cannot heal once his mineral lattice gives. Mutans Max is the sugar-eating villain who turns every sucrose hit into lactic acid and aims it straight at Eddie's face, while Sticky Sid lays down the biofilm bunker that lets the whole gang work in the dark. Deeper in, Paulie Pulp is the nerve center whose only signal is agony, because swelling inside hard walls has nowhere to go. When the structure is lost for good, NaOCl-Nate floods the dead canal and Ti-Titan drills in as the replacement, Dry-Socket Dan is the extraction site that heals wrong and screams about it, and TMJ-Tricia is the joint that makes the whole jaw seize. One page even runs under the banner SUCROSE RULEZ, four bacteria and biofilm cards stacked into a single chapter on exactly how the fortress falls.

How it works
Every card is a cognitive anchor. You get the Character (the mnemonic), the Visual (the scene), the Stat Block (the threshold, the dose, the material), the Lore (the clinical story), and the Quest (the challenge). Mechanism Flash is the brutal mode: explain why the nerve dies, or why the acid wins below pH 5.5, in one sentence without looking, or the case on the Stage gets away from you.

Honest cognitive load
This is a broad core deck for dental students who would rather argue a case out loud than reread a chapter, with enough crossover to help medical students sitting oral pathology, microbiology, or local anaesthetics. It moves from histology through surgery to prosthetics, so it rewards a learner who wants the whole arc in one sitting rather than one isolated topic. It pairs naturally with a microbiology deck for the bug fights behind the decay and a pharmacology deck for the anaesthetic and antibiotic cards that close most chapters.

ABOUT MEDKAYFAB
MedKayfab is a narrative medical learning card game, 50 decks covering the full medical curriculum. Every card encodes a clinical mechanism as a character with a personality, a story, and a reasoning challenge. Built by a physician. Assembled with AI tools. Manually revised. Honest about its limitations. Free to use, share, and adapt under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

PAY WHAT YOU WANT
This deck is Pay What You Want, including free. If you find it useful, a fair price is €5. If you are a student on a budget, enter €0, no questions asked. If you want to support more decks, anything above fair price is appreciated. Share freely, attribute honestly, never resell.

DISCLAIMER
MedKayfab is a learning companion, not a clinical reference. Content was created by a physician and reviewed to the best of our knowledge, but medicine evolves, guidelines change, and some mechanisms in here will be simplified or wrong. Always verify against current primary sources and clinical guidelines before applying anything to patient care. The Blödsinn! is the vehicle. The science is serious.
